final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM group_averages), retained AS (SELECT g.transref, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg AS first_difference FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg > o.overall_avg), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS final_avg FROM retained) SELECT r.transref, r.group_avg, r.first_difference, r.group_avg - f.final_avg AS last_difference FROM retained AS r CROSS JOIN final_average AS f WHERE f.final_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_difference IS NULL, last_difference DESC LIMIT 10
